posts.title: House Hacking
posts.instagram:
Buy 2 to 4 units. Live in one. Rent the rest.

FHA allows 3.5% down on a 2 to 4 unit home you live in. On 3 or 4 units, there's one more test: 75% of the total rent must cover the full payment. Example: 4 units × $1,400 = $5,600 × 75% = $4,200, which covers a $4,000 payment.

posts.title: Closing Day
posts.instagram:
Close on the 28th or the 3rd? It changes your cash to close.

At closing you prepay interest through the end of the month. On $350K at 6.5% (about $62.33 a day), the 28th means about $187; the 3rd means about $1,745. It's timing, not savings: same total interest. Your first payment is usually due the 1st of the month after next.
